title: cyRAVEN: Gated Multi-Sample Flow Cytometry Embedding and Differential Analysis — cyRAVEN-package
text: cyRAVEN takes directory FCS files produces gated, embedded, statistically tested result set. pipeline runs nine stages, also callable : Read – read_fcs_resolved() resolves $PnN/$PnS marker symbols applies spillover matrix file carries one. Transform – derive_cofactor_pooled() derives arcsinh cofactor data rather assuming one. Gate – apply_gate_hierarchy() derives scatter, singlet, viability CD45 gates per sample; density_valley() places marker threshold sample's bimodal split. Score – score_populations() evaluates declarative population specification (see config vignette). Embed – run_umap() builds one shared embedding per marker panel size-balanced subsample. Test – stats_group_comparison() abundance, stats_marker_state() marker state, per-sample values. Diagnose – batch_mixing_report(), stats_threshold_drift(), stats_confounding() cluster_gate_agreement(). Explain – explain_cluster() runs gating stage backwards: given cells specification describe, learns two-marker gating strategy selects . Descriptive ; proposes gates never alters scored population. Report – figures CSVs, plus write_run_manifest(). run_cyraven() runs . system.file("scripts", "cyraven.R", package = "cyRAVEN") command-line front end function.
